creator: Alexander Terp
description: Sighting 2026-11-11 (minor): after a maker closed a reviewer pane that still had the maker's thank-you post unread, the stall watch told the maker it 'has not read #6 ... no agent is in its pane any more'. A pane closed on purpose by the agent waiting on it arguably should not count as a stall.
title: A pane its maker closed on purpose is reported as a stall
